name: SAM (Segment Anything)
license_interpretation: Apache-2.0 is a permissive license, so this code and these weights can be used in commercial and closed-source products. It asks you to keep the license text and attribution notices with any copy you redistribute, and it grants a patent license. LibreYOLO does not mirror SAM-1 weights on its own Hugging Face org: LibreSAM downloads the base, large and huge checkpoints directly from Meta's own facebook/sam-vit-base, facebook/sam-vit-large and facebook/sam-vit-huge repositories, each tagged Apache-2.0 there as well.
